title: A City Weighs Three Public-Space Proposals
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，完成10道题。短文和题目均为英文，解释为中文。本材料为模拟教学练习，不是官方雅思考试。请先通读全文，再做题。填空题答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。
passage:
A city council in the town of Riverton is considering three proposals for a new public space. The proposals were submitted by local groups, and they are being reviewed by a committee this month. The committee will decide which plan is chosen. Each proposal has strengths and weaknesses, and residents have been invited to share their opinions.

Proposal A: A Community Garden
This plan would turn an empty lot near the library into a community garden. The garden would be divided into small plots, and each plot would be rented to a family for a small fee. The money collected would be used to buy tools and seeds. Volunteers would take care of the shared areas. The garden would provide fresh vegetables and a quiet place to relax. However, some residents worry that the garden would attract insects and require a lot of water. Also, the lot is small, so only about twenty families could have plots.

Proposal B: A Children's Playground
This proposal suggests building a playground on the same empty lot. The playground would include swings, slides, and a climbing frame. It would be designed for children aged three to twelve. The equipment would be made of safe materials, and a soft surface would be installed under the play areas. Parents have supported this idea because the town currently has no playground. The council has received many letters in favor of the playground. On the other hand, the playground would be noisy, and it would not be open in the evening. Some older residents have said that they prefer a quieter space.

Proposal C: A Small Park with Benches
A third group wants to create a small park with trees, flowers, and benches. This plan would cost more than the other two because trees and benches are expensive. The park would be open to everyone at all times. It would provide shade in summer and a place for people to sit and talk. The group argues that a park would make the neighborhood more beautiful and would increase property values. However, the council must consider the cost. The city budget is limited, and the park would require ongoing maintenance.

The committee will hold a public meeting next week. At the meeting, residents can ask questions and express their views. The committee will then make a recommendation to the council. The final decision is expected by the end of the month. The chosen project will be funded by the city, and work will begin in the spring.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the passage?
options: To describe three proposals for a public space and the decision process.
To explain how to grow vegetables in a community garden.
To compare the cost of playground equipment.
To advertise a new park in Riverton.
answers: To describe three proposals for a public space and the decision process.
questions.explanation: 文章主要介绍三个公共空间提案以及委员会的决策过程。其他选项只涉及细节或并非文章目的。
questions.evidence: A city council in the town of Riverton is considering three proposals for a new public space.

questions.prompt: According to the passage, how would the community garden be funded?
options: By renting small plots to families.
answers: By renting small plots to families.
questions.explanation: 原文说每个小块地租给家庭，收取少量费用，这笔钱用于买工具和种子。
questions.evidence: each plot would be rented to a family for a small fee. The money collected would be used to buy tools and seeds.

questions.prompt: Which proposal has received many letters of support?
options: Proposal C: A Small Park with Benches
questions.explanation: 原文明确说委员会收到许多支持游乐场的信。
questions.evidence: The council has received many letters in favor of the playground.

questions.prompt: Why does Proposal C cost more than the other two?
options: Because trees and benches are expensive.
Because it is open only in the evening.
answers: Because trees and benches are expensive.
questions.explanation: 原文直接说明这个计划花费更多是因为树木和长椅很贵。
questions.evidence: This plan would cost more than the other two because trees and benches are expensive.

questions.prompt: What is a concern about the playground?
options: It would be open all night.
questions.explanation: 原文提到游乐场会吵闹，这是人们担忧的问题。其他选项是其他提案的特点。
questions.evidence: On the other hand, the playground would be noisy, and it would not be open in the evening.

questions.prompt: When is the final decision expected?
options: By the end of the month.
answers: By the end of the month.
questions.explanation: 原文说最终决定预计在月底前做出。
questions.evidence: The final decision is expected by the end of the month.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with ONE WORD from the passage: The garden would be divided into small ______.
questions.explanation: 原文说花园会被分成小块地（plots）。
questions.evidence: The garden would be divided into small plots

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with ONE WORD from the passage: The playground would include swings, slides, and a climbing ______.
questions.explanation: 原文列出游乐场包括秋千、滑梯和攀爬架（climbing frame）。
questions.evidence: The playground would include swings, slides, and a climbing frame.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: The community garden would be open to everyone at all times.
questions.explanation: 原文说公园（Proposal C）才对所有人全天开放；花园是租给家庭的小块地，并非全天开放给所有人。因此该陈述与原文矛盾。
questions.evidence: The park would be open to everyone at all times.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: The committee has already chosen Proposal B.
questions.explanation: 原文说委员会将在下个月开会后提出建议，最终决定月底才做出，所以尚未选择。
questions.evidence: The committee will then make a recommendation to the council. The final decision is expected by the end of the month.

grammar.title: 被动语态；因果表达；分词作定语的基础辨认
grammar.explanation: 本课重点：1) 被动语态：be + 过去分词，强调动作承受者。例如：The proposals were submitted. 2) 因果表达：because, so, therefore, as a result 等。例如：because trees and benches are expensive. 3) 分词作定语：单个分词放在名词前，如 the chosen project；分词短语放在名词后，如 the money collected。辨认时先找名词，再看分词修饰谁。
grammar.example: The proposals were submitted by local groups, and they are being reviewed by a committee this month.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive form: The new library ______ next year.
questions.explanation: 图书馆是被建造，用被动语态 will be + 过去分词。
questions.evidence: The chosen project will be funded by the city

questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive form: The letters ______ by the committee yesterday.
questions.explanation: 信是被审查，过去时被动用 were + 过去分词。
questions.evidence: they are being reviewed by a committee

questions.prompt: Choose the best causal word: The park costs more ______ trees and benches are expensive.
questions.explanation: 后面是原因，用 because 引导原因状语从句。
questions.evidence: This plan would cost more than the other two because trees and benches are expensive.

questions.prompt: Choose the best causal word: The budget is limited, ______ the park may not be approved.
questions.explanation: 前面是原因，后面是结果，用 so 连接。
questions.evidence: The city budget is limited, and the park would require ongoing maintenance.

questions.prompt: Identify the participle used as an adjective: In 'the chosen project', which word is the participle?
questions.explanation: chosen 是过去分词，放在名词 project 前作定语。
questions.evidence: The chosen project will be funded by the city

questions.prompt: Identify the participle phrase: In 'the money collected', what does 'collected' modify?
questions.explanation: collected 是过去分词短语，修饰前面的名词 money。
questions.evidence: The money collected would be used to buy tools and seeds.

options: The playground would be designed for children.
The playground would design for children.
The playground would designing for children.
The playground would designs for children.
answers: The playground would be designed for children.
questions.explanation: 游乐场是被设计，用被动 would be + 过去分词。
questions.evidence: It would be designed for children aged three to twelve.

questions.prompt: Choose the best causal word: ______ the garden is small, only twenty families can have plots.
questions.explanation: 前后是因果关系，前面是原因，用 Because。
questions.evidence: the lot is small, so only about twenty families could have plots.
